claim: Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar teach evals as an error-analysis loop: open coding 50-100 traces, axial coding into categories, quantify via pivot tables, then build binary LLM-as-judge graders aligned to human labels.
quote: Product managers manually review 50-100 production traces... Use binary (true/false) scoring, not Likert scales... When you're shipping products, you make binary decisions.

claim: AI Evals for Engineers & PMs by Hamel Husain and Shreya Shankar is the dominant live cohort course on evals, focused on systematically improving AI apps with hands-on coding homework.
quote: AI Evals For Engineers & PMs by Hamel Husain and Shreya Shankar on Maven

claim: DeepEval is a Python-native framework integrating into pytest with 50+ metrics; Braintrust offers deployment-blocking quality gates; Phoenix is OpenTelemetry-based and free self-hosted.
quote: DeepEval - Python-native framework integrating directly into pytest with 50+ metrics... Braintrust... Distinguishing feature: deployment-blocking quality gates based on eval scores.

claim: DeepEval workflow: LLMTestCase objects, GEval custom LLM-as-judge metrics with 0-1 thresholds, Golden/EvaluationDataset objects, run via `deepeval test run` and assert_test.
quote: deepeval test run test_example.py ... GEval(name='Correctness', criteria='Determine correctness...', threshold=0.5) ... EvaluationDataset(goldens=[Golden(input='...')])

claim: DeepEval plugs into GitHub Actions; if any metric falls below its threshold, assert_test fails, deepeval test run exits non-zero, and the CI job fails, blocking PR merges.
quote: If any metric falls below its threshold, the assert_test function fails, causing the poetry run deepeval test run command to exit with a non-zero status code. This automatically fails the GitHub Actions job, blocking PR merges.

claim: OpenAI acquired Promptfoo (announced March 2026); Promptfoo remains open source under its current license with continued support.
quote: We're acquiring Promptfoo... Promptfoo will remain open source under the current license, and we will continue to service and support current customers.

claim: OpenAI acquired Promptfoo on March 9, 2026 for ~$86M, with concerns raised in the community about long-term provider neutrality.
quote: OpenAI acquires Promptfoo to secure its AI agents

claim: Promptfoo is a declarative YAML eval and red-teaming tool with CLI and CI/CD integration, comparing GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek; used by OpenAI and Anthropic.
quote: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI... Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration. Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.

claim: Evidently's LLM evaluations course teaches custom LLM judges, synthetic test-case generation, evaluation dataset design, tracing, guardrails, and RAG/agent evaluation; no coding required for the intro track, applied code track follows.
quote: from evaluation methods and benchmarks to LLM guardrails and creating custom LLM judges... How to design evaluation datasets and use synthetic data to generate varied test cases.

claim: LLM-as-a-judge is positioned as the best scalable LLM evaluation method; teams should spot-check 5-10% of judge verdicts against human judgment.
quote: spot-checking 5-10% of judge verdicts against human judgment is recommended

claim: 2026 CI/CD eval patterns: tag each golden with its route, diff the PR to run only affected routes, and assert on pass_rate, avg_score, and p50/p90/p95 score percentiles.
quote: Native assertion conditions cover pass_rate, avg_score, p50_score, p90_score, p95_score, and runtime percentiles, with percentile assertions useful for long-tail failures.

claim: In DeepEval a dataset is a collection of Goldens; a Golden is a precursor to a test case, converted to LLMTestCase objects at evaluation time, loadable from CSV/JSON or the cloud.
quote: an evaluation dataset is a collection of goldens, a golden is a precursor to a test case

claim: A workshop's defining feature is interactive hands-on participation and problem-solving; a talk/conference is for broad listening, exposure and networking.
quote: The defining feature of a workshop is its interactive and hands-on nature, with the primary goal being to actively participate in training or problem-solving rather than just listen.

claim: Braintrust and other platforms are positioned as Promptfoo alternatives in 2026 offering eval, prompt management and CI/CD quality gates.
quote: Best Promptfoo alternatives in 2026: Open-source tools and SaaS

claim: An LLM-as-a-judge is an LLM prompted to score the quality of another LLM's output; building one well requires a clear rubric and validation against human labels.
quote: LLM-as-a-judge: a complete guide to using LLMs for evaluations

claim: Arize Phoenix is an OpenTelemetry-based, vendor-neutral, free self-hostable eval and tracing tool.
quote: Built on OpenTelemetry for vendor neutrality. Self-hosted version is completely free with no feature restrictions.

claim: Weights & Biases ships a hands-on LLM apps evaluation course with step-by-step projects building reliable production eval pipelines.
quote: LLM apps evaluation course: Build reliable pipelines for production

claim: The Hamel/Shreya course homework uses a 'Recipe Bot' as a shared toy app for error analysis and eval-building exercises.
quote: AI Evals Maven Course Homework: the Recipe Bot Workflow

claim: DeepEval unit testing in CI/CD loads goldens from Confident AI, CSV, or JSON, converts them to test cases, and runs the same evals locally and on every push/PR.
